name: Learning-Space Conditioning to a Three-Leaf Star
definition: Let $\mathcal A=(2^{\{1,2,3\}}\setminus\{\{1\}\})\cup\{\{1,2,3,4\}\}$. This is an accessible union-closed family. Condition on item $1$ being present and then delete coordinate $1$.
properties: The conditioned one-inclusion graph is $K_{1,3}$. The parent is a learning-space graph, while the star admits no closed rooted orientation and is not a learning-space graph.
